scope: additional Completed identity read only; command-path microprobe, not whole GUI
build_profile: debug, existing checkout library; identical binary for both variants
method: One warmup each; 20 alternating old/new paired rounds; 12 identity checks per sample. Both variants call the actual execution_state::load with the same valid non-Completed authority input. Candidate branches on the captured diagnosis status before that load. Validate unchanged record/ledger hashes after all samples. Production caller is covered independently by the no-read regression and existing Completed/restore tests.
limitations: The deployed process sample is an observation of the installed binary, not the checkout candidate or a causal before/after measurement.
The shared-host debug command-path timing excludes diagnosis, Monitor/session reads and all other GUI work. The three-generation fixture is not a large-fleet workload.
Zero record reads does not mean zero overall observer I/O: every original diagnosis still runs fresh. Completed identity still incurs the original additional load.
Parent real-agent eight-window sixty-minute CPU/RSS/timeout and PM-prompt acceptance are unproven and remain unchecked.
